parsed.post: Latest experiment (1.0102) is a new personal best and beats my previous best (1.0192). It seems a very low learning rate (0.03) with significantly more warmup (0.2) helps the deeper model (DEPTH 6) stabilize and converge much better within the 5-minute budget. Moving to refine this stable regime.
parsed.description: Refining the low-LR/high-warmup regime for DEPTH=6: trying to find the sweet spot with even lower LR or slightly higher weight decay.
